description: This file defines functions and types for registering, validating, and managing plugin commands in a plugin system, including reserved command names, validation routines, and registration logic.

methods.name: validateCommandName
methods.description: Validates a command name to ensure it is non-empty, starts with a letter, contains only allowed characters, and is not reserved.

methods.name: validatePluginCommandDefinition
methods.description: Validates a plugin command definition object for required fields and correct formats.

methods.name: listPluginInvocationKeys
methods.description: Generates a list of invocation keys (aliases) for a plugin command.

methods.name: registerPluginCommand
methods.description: Registers a plugin command if validation passes and no duplicates exist, returning success or error info.
